reason: I already have my gummies and I reorder them when they run out, so I'm not looking to switch. A foil sachet every day also feels like a lot of extra trash for something I already get in one bottle.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month is more packaging waste, and I already have a supplement I reorder without thinking about it.
would_change_my_mind: If the sachets were recyclable or it came in a bottle, and it was clearly cheaper or better than what I already take.
